items: You decide how much to contribute toward employee premiums. Receive one monthly bill for all your coverage, making it easier to manage and budget for health benefits.

cards.label: Let Employees Choose Their Plans
items: Employees pick the plans that work best for their needs and budget from the options you offer. Enrollment is year-round, so adding or removing employees is easy.

cards.label: Coverage Levels
items: The coverage levels — Platinum, Gold, Silver and Bronze — organize plans by how costs are shared between the plan and the employee. Higher tiers generally mean lower out-of-pocket costs for employees and higher monthly premiums.

cards.label: Networks
items: Each carrier has its own network of doctors, hospitals and service areas. Review network summaries to understand which providers may be available to your employees.

cards.label: Plan and Benefit Summaries
items: CCSB provides standard benefit summaries for each plan tier. Review these documents to compare what each plan covers and how benefits may have changed from the prior year.

cards.label: Creditable Coverage
items: If your business has Medicare-eligible employees, you may be required to provide an annual written notice about whether your prescription drug coverage is creditable, meaning it meets Medicare Part D standards.
